title: Weird toy store I keep returning too.
content: I’ve had the same dream several times over the years… I’m with my Gradmother and we are in a mall (old mall from the 70’s) and down a long long hallway on the right there is a toy store with no other stores around. In this dream it’s so detailed that I can pick up and read the warnings on the packages. The toys in the store are all from the late 60s early 70’s so before Star Wars changed the toy isles forever. I remember 2 low tables filled with games and coloring books, with shelves running the perimeter of the store. The store itself was brightly lit with windows and skylights… I usually get about 15 min in to looking at the merchandise before my grandmother calls me back to her side and I leave the toy store and the dream behind for a while longer… I know I’ll be visiting again as this same dream has happened for years.
